text:
anita: Thanks everyone for coming — quick follow-up from today's AH with the things I said I'd post.

matt: recording + slides here: https://redwood.ai/slides/ah-2026
lee: can you paste the bit about Dedicated timeline?
anita: Dedicated GA target = end of Q3; pilot starts next week for a few existing customers. we'll share pilot signup form.
olivia: timeline note — pilot = limited regions (us-west), will add eu and apac post-pilot.
jess: billing question — will pilot be free? any usage caps?
anita: pilot is free for selected accounts; PLG credits apply. for commercial pricing we'll share firm numbers in next update.
matt: action: @jess to own pilot eligibility checklist (deliverable: onboarding doc) — due 2026-07-05 :calendar: 
jess: on it. putting draft in #docs by EOD tomorrow.
lee: request: more examples of model quantization tradeoffs.
anita: agree. @olivia to collate 3 short case studies (latency vs quality) — target 2 weeks.
olivia: adding to my backlog. will ping for dataset access.
sre-bot: deploy notice — canary build for dedicated-pilot infra scheduled 2026-06-20 22:00 UTC
matt: small clarif on private deployment — will there be an offline/on-prem installer?
anita: yes — on-prem package planned for GA; will be an optional artifact. current plan: customer-managed control plane and an install script for air-gapped infra.
lee: can we get a CLI snippet for requesting trial access?
matt: here's a minimal example:
```
# request dedicated pilot
rwctl request-pilot --team=my-team --region=us-west --quota=100k
```
matt: that will create a ticket in Ops and route to SE.
olivia: question about rollouts: canary % thresholds and automatic rollback?
anita: rollout policy: default canary 5%, step to 25% if no errors, health check = 1 min sustained. auto-rollback on p99 latency spike > 2x baseline or error rate > 0.5%.
jess: will those policies be configurable per-customer?
anita: yes — configurable on Dedicated and Private; Hosted will expose sane presets + advanced controls for enterprise tiers.
matt: action: @lee to add rollout policy defaults to console docs — due 2026-06-30.
lee: creating PR after this thread.
olivia: can we get a shortened FAQ for sales and SEs?
anita: yes — @matt + @olivia to own short FAQ + TL;DR (2 pages) — due next Tue.
matt: noting owners. i'll pair with @olivia.
jess: small ask — can we get a sample prompt for the eval suite used in benchmarks?
anita: will share the seed prompts repo link tomorrow.
zoom-bot: recording uploaded: https://zoom.us/rec/abc123 (access: company)
anita: thanks all. if you raised something i didn't answer here, DM me or drop in #product-asks. :raised_hands:
